statement: ∀ (R h : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ j : Fin n, |x j| < R) → 0 < R → 0 < h → let m := ⌈2*R/h⌉₊; let w := 2*R/(m:ℝ); let t : (Fin n → Fin m) → Set (V n) := fun f => {x | ∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Icc (-R + (f j : ℕ)*w) (-R + ((f j : ℕ)+1)*w)}; E ⊆ ⋃ f, t f ∧ ∀ f, Metric.ediam (t f) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt n * h)
proof:
intro R h hR hRp hh m w t
have hm : 0 < (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.2 (Nat.ceil_pos.2 (by positivity))
have hw : 0 < w := div_pos (by positivity) hm
have hwm : w * (m:ℝ) = 2*R := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hm.ne'
have hwh : w ≤ h := by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hm).2
  have hc := (div_le_iff₀ hh).1 (Nat.le_ceil (2*R/h))
  nlinarith
constructor
· intro x hx
  let f : Fin n → Fin m := fun j => ⟨⌊(x j + R)/w⌋₊, by
    apply (Nat.floor_lt (div_nonneg (by linarith [(abs_lt.1 (hR x hx j)).1]) hw.le)).2
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hw).2
    nlinarith [(abs_lt.1 (hR x hx j)).2]⟩
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨f, ?_⟩
  intro j
  have hnon : 0 ≤ (x j + R)/w := div_nonneg (by linarith [(abs_lt.1 (hR x hx j)).1]) hw.le
  have hlo := Nat.floor_le hnon
  have hhi := Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((x j + R)/w)
  dsimp [t, f]
  constructor
  · have := (le_div_iff₀ hw).1 hlo
    linarith
  · have := (div_lt_iff₀ hw).1 hhi
    linarith
· intro f
  apply Metric.ediam_le_of_forall_dist_le
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
  calc
    Real.sqrt (∑ j, dist (x j) (y j) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ _j : Fin n, h^2) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      have hxy : dist (x j) (y j) ≤ h := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_le]
        have hxj := hx j
        have hyj := hy j
        constructor <;> nlinarith [hxj.1, hxj.2, hyj.1, hyj.2]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ dist_nonneg hxy 2
    _ = Real.sqrt n * h := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg n), Real.sqrt_sq hh.le]
